subject: Incentive bridge / fallback plan for Medlytics RFP evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@medlytics.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Incentive bridge proposal for Medlytics evaluation

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the candid note on where the bake-off stands. I pulled the usage report from your sandbox (attached) and a quick read suggests the spike in token spend came in the initial ingestion/embedding step, not steady-state evals.

To keep momentum for the RFP we can offer a short-term bridge package to cover the immediate risk you called out:
- 30 days of additional sandbox credits (12k USD equivalent) applied to your project ID
- Conditional extension of the evaluation window by 45 days if you commit to the follow-up POC checklist in the SOW
- An escrow-style clawback: unused credits convert to a credit on your account; we reserve the right to withdraw if we see misuse (detailed language below)

If that sounds workable I can route the paperwork today; otherwise tell me what scale you need and I’ll run numbers with Ops.

Attaching: trial-usage-report.csv for your review.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0184

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@medlytics.ai>

Cc: Medlytics Procurement <procurement@medlytics.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incentive bridge proposal for Medlytics evaluation

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick read and the proposed bridge. The usage file helped. Two follow-ups from our side:
1) Procurement asked whether the credits can be split: half applied immediately for ingestion fixes, half reserved for later benchmarking rounds.
2) We need a 60-day extension instead of 45 days because our clinical data compliance review is taking longer than expected.

If Redwood can commit to a 50/50 split of the credit payment and a 60-day extension, procurement says we can fast-track the SOW and sign within the week. Otherwise we risk the vendor parity clause kicking in and we have to open the bake-off to two other providers.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

—Sarah
Sarah Lin
Head of Product, Medlytics
sarah.lin@medlytics.ai

Subject: Fwd: Incentive bridge proposal for Medlytics evaluation — approval ask

Team —

Looping you in. Medlytics is asking for a 60-day extension and a split credit arrangement (half now, half reserved). Quick summary / ask:
- Proposed total bridge: USD 12,000 in credits (our list: 30-day immediate consumption credit + 30-day reserved credit)
- Customer asks to convert the reserved portion into a future benchmarking credit if unused; procurement wants this documented in the SOW
- They asked to increase extension to 60 days (they cite compliance clearance) — this pushes our window but reduces churn risk

Risks and mitigations I see:
- Abuse: if they consume credits purely for load testing, it costs us. Mitigate via prefix-level limits + usage pattern clause.
- Opponents: Finance will push back on $12k out-of-cycle credits unless we tie it to the deal (RDW-DEAL-2026-091) and mark as non-refundable promotional credit

Recommended compromise (for internal approval):
- Approve USD 12k split credit: 6k active now, 6k escrowed for benchmark rounds (expires 90 days after activation if unused)
- Approve 60-day extension to the evaluation window (instead of 45)
- Require signature on updated SOW with explicit usage guardrails and a simple clawback (we recover value if pattern indicates non-eval behavior)

Attached: Medlytics_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (I redlined the escrow language). If you’re good I’ll send a formal offer and DocuSign link today.

—Jordan

Subject: RE: Incentive bridge proposal for Medlytics evaluation — final offer

Sarah / Procurement —

Thanks for the clarity. We want to keep Medlytics in the lead for the RFP and have agreement from Finance to the following final terms:

1) Credits: USD 12,000 total promo credits (non-refundable promotional credit)
   - USD 6,000 applied immediately to project ID MLA-9842 (covers ingestion/embedding spike)
   - USD 6,000 held as benchmark escrow credit: reserved and applied only for subsequent benchmark rounds; expires 90 days after initial activation if unused

2) Extension: 60-day evaluation extension from the current contract expiry date

3) Guardrails: usage caps (per-prefix and per-minute token limits), and a simple clawback clause for clear abuse (examples: sustained synthetic load beyond expected eval patterns).

4) Execution: we’ll send an updated SOW and DocuSign link (HubSpot deal RDW-DEAL-2026-091). Please confirm that Procurement can sign by EOD Thursday so we can lock the reserved credits in the system.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/doc/xyz-bridge-2026
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/3245

If Procurement needs the exact clawback language in advance I can paste the redline here — otherwise I’ll route the SOW now for signature.

Best —
